instruction:
I want to change where VLC saves video snapshots. Please configure VLC to save snapshots to my Pictures folder instead of the default location.
How can I set the snapshot directory?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting VLC's snapshot directory to /home/user/Pictures (snapshot-path=/home/user/Pictures). Created custom metric function check_vlc_snapshot_directory__b9846f28.
